scoring_justification: Agent submits final λ and Tc; full recompute from α²F(ω) is not possible without the raw spectral function. Reference match with 20% λ / 30% Tc tolerance is used, supplemented by structural N(EF) monotonicity check.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold λ and Tc values for Li0.95Be0.05H, Na0.8Mg0.2H, K0.55Ca0.45H
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Phys. Rev. B 99, 214504 (2019); λ values: 0.473 (LiBeH), 1.26 (NaMgH), 1.69 (KCaH); Tc values: 2.1 K, 28 K, 49 K. Exact LiBeH λ=0.473 from text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper's abstract and body
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper's reported numbers, matching solve.sh reference

outputs.description: Electronic density of states at the Fermi level as a function of alkaline-earth doping for LiBeH, NaMgH, and KCaH alloys. The rows for each system must be in order of increasing doping.
Electron-phonon coupling constant λ and superconducting critical temperature Tc (μ* = 0.1) for the three alloys at maximum stable doping.

output_contract.notes: The agent must perform all calculations from first principles using an open-source DFT/DFPT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO + EPW). The Eliashberg equations must be solved with Coulomb pseudopotential μ* = 0.1. No external/pre-computed data beyond pseudopotentials is allowed.

steps.description: Verify that for each alloy system N_EF is 0 at undoped case and increases monotonically with doping
Compare agent-reported λ and Tc to hidden paper gold with generous relative tolerances (20% for λ, 30% for Tc)
